title: WAGO
summary: WAGO PFC200 controllers run CODESYS-based runtimes with the WAGO I/O System 750 modules.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body: PFC200 controllers with 750/753 I/O modules on the same rail; Ethernet and fieldbus variants exist.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: No simulation profile; WAGO concepts are background knowledge. Programs written for the `generic.iec` profile use the same IEC 61131-3 Structured Text ideas. **CONCEPTUAL**.
